subject.title: feat(memory): carry source actor context into recall

question: Should OpenClaw accept SourceActor as the public plugin/message/memory attribution contract for this stack, or should the contract be renamed or narrowed before release?
rationale: The PR adds public plugin-facing context and memory supplement parameters whose naming, scalar mirrors, and privacy boundary become compatibility commitments after release; code correctness alone cannot choose that product contract.

options.title: Approve SourceActor Contract
options.body: Treat this PR as the memory follow-up after the prerequisite Signal/source-actor stack lands and keep the optional sourceActor plumbing as the release contract.

options.title: Rename Or Narrow Contract
options.body: Ask for a revised API surface before release if maintainers want different names, fewer scalar mirrors, or stricter privacy boundaries.

options.title: Pause The Stack
options.body: Leave the PR draft or close later if maintainers decide participant attribution should be structurally stored before being exposed as best-effort context.

recommendation.title: Approve SourceActor Contract
recommendation.body: Treat this PR as the memory follow-up after the prerequisite Signal/source-actor stack lands and keep the optional sourceActor plumbing as the release contract.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision is mainly about public plugin/message context shape, where the strongest recent boundary history points to steipete.
